title: Apply for a conditional vehicle registration
summary: Apply for a conditional vehicle registration if your vehicle needs limited road access because it does not meet standard construction requirements.
intro:
If you need road access and your vehicle doesn't comply with standard construction and equipment requirements, you'll have to apply for a conditional vehicle registration. This will allow limited access to the road network to perform specific functions.

You can apply and pay for this registration at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: Conditional registration will not be offered if a complying vehicle can be used instead.
who_can_apply: The vehicle must require limited road access to perform specific functions because it does not comply with standard construction and equipment requirements.
Check the Conditional Registration Vehicle Sheets to determine if your vehicle is eligible.
what_you_need: The 'Application for Conditional Registration' PDF form.
Declaration of Eligibility for a Registration Concession (Form 1193), if the vehicle is for farming purposes.
Proof of suitability for safe use, which can be one of the following:
Proof of identity (for individual, organisation, and/or representative).
Proof of your entitlement to register the vehicle.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the relevant form from the following list:
Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and submit your application and payment.

faqs.q: Who needs a conditional vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You need this if you require road access, but your vehicle does not comply with standard construction and equipment requirements.

faqs.q: Can I apply for this registration online?
faqs.a: No, you must apply and pay for this registration at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Will I get a conditional registration if a standard vehicle is available?
faqs.a: No, conditional registration will not be offered if a complying vehicle can be used instead.
